name: Jira
description: Jira Cloud issues. Each Jira project is a collection. Restrict the connection to some projects in the settings.

settings.label: Site URL
settings.description: The URL of your Jira Cloud site, for example "https://acme.atlassian.net".

settings.label: Email
settings.description: The email of your Atlassian account.

settings.label: API token
settings.description: An API token of your Atlassian account. Open id.atlassian.com/manage-profile/security/api-tokens and click "Create API token". Do not use a token with scopes.
